product: Okta connector is available in Beta
tagline: The managed Okta connector is now available in Beta in Databricks Lakeflow Connect.
what_it_does: The managed Okta connector is now available in Beta in Databricks Lakeflow Connect. Workspace admins can enable Lakeflow Connect for Okta on the Previews page. Use the connector to ingest identity and access data from Okta into Databricks, including users, groups, group memberships, app integrations, devices, policies, and administrator roles.
why_it_matters: Reduces operational overhead and unlocks new capabilities for data teams on Databricks.
plain_summary: The managed Okta connector is now available in Beta in Databricks Lakeflow Connect. Workspace admins can enable Lakeflow Connect for Okta on the Previews page.
key_takeaway: The managed Okta connector is now available in Beta in Databricks Lakeflow Connect.
